title: Polynomial regression under a mixture of classical and Berkson errors
summary: A polynomial structural regression model is studied, where the covariate is observed with a mixture of the classical and Berkson measurement errors. Both variances of the classical and Berkson errors, as well as some of their higher moments are assumed to be known. Without normality assumptions, consistent estimators of model parameters are constructed using the Corrected Score method, and conditions for their asymptotic normality are given. Under mild conditions, we found pairs of asymptotically independent estimators. A simulation study illustrates the results.
